title: Dual Branding Lock-ups
slide_intent: Explain how to align partner marks whose shapes and lettering differ. A common baseline and measured gap make the relationship legible without forcing both marks into identical boxes.
strategic_value: CSAIL can acknowledge outside partners while preserving the proportional structure of its own program signatures.
demonstration: Two lockups pair CSAIL Alliances with STL Fintech and the Advanced Networks Architecture Group with IBM. Blue guides span the pairs to label baseline, height and separation.
practical_value: Choose a comparable visual height and baseline for the partner, then measure the minimum gap using the CSAIL exclusion unit.

content_islands.name: Relationship rules
content_islands.spec: Define the lockup and list baseline, suggested area and total height in the left rail.

content_islands.name: Partner comparisons
content_islands.spec: Stack two pairings across the pale panel. Carry guide lines through both marks, label the variable gaps and retain the minimum-distance markers.
